authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No 'choose' cards that aren't votes (decisions L43, L45).
No Tempt with Reflections without a legend-rule workaround (L65).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Five mana for two static modifiers; little happens without the cards they modify.
Villainous Choices and votes let opponents pick the least bad option.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Arcane Denial, Deadly Rollick, Feed the Swarm, Chaos Warp, Cyclonic Rift, Blasphemous Act.
value.mana: 36 lands; Arid Mesa replaced a dead Windswept Heath.
value.protection: Deflecting Swat, Lightning Greaves, Force of Will.

accepted_role.advances_plan: The Valeyard doubles every Villainous Choice and adds a vote; nonlegendary copies add more.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native but narrow: two static modifiers, no body-based engine, and no Spellbook combos; the source asserts no infinite (decisions L76). Copies stack additively, not exponentially (L74). The source rejected Prisoner's Dilemma and Seize the Spotlight because 'choose' isn't 'vote' (CR 701.38c). The deck's power comes from its staples more than the commander; expect low Bracket 4.
